description: The job model of long-running commands (calibration, modal stages, MIDI file playback). Served by the :5000 executor itself.

commands.name: job.list
commands.title: List jobs
commands.description: The recent jobs (newest first, up to 50): {id, name, family, state, pct, stage, msg, result, error, started_at, finished_at, source}.

commands.name: job.get
commands.title: Get a job
commands.description: One job by id. wait_s > 0 waits (at most that long) for the job to end before answering: follow a long step with job.get {jobId, wait_s: 60} instead of many quick polls.

wait_s.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the job to finish / fail / be cancelled (0 = answer at once)

commands.name: job.cancel
commands.title: Cancel a job
commands.description: Cancels a running job through its family's own cancel (calibration -> calibration.cancel, modal -> modal.cancel, midi_playback -> play.midi_file_stop).
